data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 27/1144Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: PREPARATIONS TO PROTECT LIFE AND PROPERTY SHOULD BE RUSHED TO COMPLETION IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR AS POWERFUL POLO APPROACHES. As of 5:00 AM MST Sun Sep 27 the center of Polo was located near 20.7, -113.7 with movement NNW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 952 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 120 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Eighteen-E (EP3), advisory 27/0855Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: TROPICAL DEPRESSION EIGHTEEN-E FORMS SOUTH OF MEXICO. As of 3:00 AM CST Sun Sep 27 the center of Eighteen-E was located near 12.2, -99.1 with movement WNW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1008 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Odalys (EP1), advisory 27/0853Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: ODALYS RAPIDLY LOSING STRENGTH AS A CATEGORY ONE HURRICANE. As of 2:00 AM PDT Sun Sep 27 the center of Odalys was located near 21.9, -123.4 with movement N at 8 mph. The minimum central pressure was 985 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 75 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 27/0850Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY HOLDING STEADY AS IT MOVES SOUTHWARD. As of 9:00 AM GMT Sun Sep 27 the center of Fay was located near 29.2, -43.9 with movement S at 3 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1010 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.
